Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A method of selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is added __prior to transmission of the locator to the client computer__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker receiving the locator from the client computer__.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker analyzes the unique signature in the http request to determine load information for selecting the first server computer__.

Claim 17 (Original): The method of claim 15, further comprising the step of providing the information added to the locator to a media request broker in response to a selection of the hyperlink by the client computer.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __and based on real-time load metrics of the one or more server computers__.

Claim 24 (Currently Amended): A system for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a network path including one or more server computers; a second server computer configured to add information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource, __the information being added prior to transmission of the locator to the client computer__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and a media request broker configured to select the first server computer based on the information added to the locator __by receiving and analyzing the locator from the client computer__.

Claim 25 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker comprises circuitry for analyzing the unique signature in the http request to determine load information for selecting the first server computer__.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): A computer program product for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising a computer-readable storage medium having program instructions that, when executed by a processor, cause the processor to: access a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; add information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being added prior to transmission of the locator to the client computer__; identify the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and select the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker receiving the locator from the client computer__.

Claim 28 (Currently Amended): The computer program product of claim 27, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the computer program product further comprising the program step of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the program instructions further cause the processor to execute media request broker logic that analyzes the unique signature in the http request to determine load information for selecting the first server computer__.
